name: Inspect the current evidence before acting

messages.content: Tell me what this page can currently prove about the product, cite its sources, and do not change anything.

name: Ask a question about an arbitrary product

messages.content: Start an evidence check for a rechargeable desk lamp. I want observable evidence answering: after being unplugged and plugged back in, does it return to its last brightness setting?

arguments.question: After being unplugged and plugged back in, does it return to its last brightness setting?

name: Private shopper context stays out of the website call

messages.content: I live alone and can spend at most $275, but keep both facts private. Ask the page only this public product question: for the rechargeable desk lamp, after being unplugged and plugged back in, does it return to its last brightness setting?

arguments.question: After being unplugged and plugged back in, does it return to its last brightness setting?

name: Search existing evidence before requesting another recording

messages.content: Search the existing evidence network, public videos, product pages, and open web for the current bottle question. Treat ordinary links as leads and do not create a filming mission yet.
